text: WELCOME. I am Dr. Agent. I am here to examine you and understand your symptoms. Please tell me, what specific health issues have you noticed with your newborn baby?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus.

Given the history of no prenatal care and unavailable immunization records in a newborn delivered at term, I am concerned about a lack of maternal tetanus toxoid immunity and subsequent exposure to a contaminated umbilical stump. Do you notice any difficulty feeding, excessive crying, or generalized muscle stiffness/jaw locking in the infant?
